availability_rules_effective_dates_check.name: availability_rules_effective_dates_check
availability_rules_effective_dates_check.value: "availability_rules"."effective_until" is null or "availability_rules"."effective_from" is null or "availability_rules"."effective_from" <= "availability_rules"."effective_until"

messages_context_check.name: messages_context_check
messages_context_check.value: ("messages"."application_id" is not null) <> ("messages"."booking_id" is not null)

ratings_context_check.name: ratings_context_check
ratings_context_check.value: ("ratings"."application_id" is not null) <> ("ratings"."booking_id" is not null)

ratings_single_target_check.name: ratings_single_target_check
ratings_single_target_check.value: ("ratings"."braider_id" is not null) <> ("ratings"."salon_id" is not null)

service_providers_identity_check.name: service_providers_identity_check
service_providers_identity_check.value:
(
        ("service_providers"."provider_type" = 'salon' and "service_providers"."salon_id" is not null and "service_providers"."braider_id" is null)
        or
        ("service_providers"."provider_type" = 'braider' and "service_providers"."braider_id" is not null and "service_providers"."salon_id" is null)
      )
